cyclic_prefix_controls.scope: Integer unit operations on constant-size excluded coefficient matrices, independently compared with sparse Gaussian ranks of original monomials in the full integral quotient. Composite m and primes not dividing m are included.

universal_binary_rank_controls.scope: Original monomial columns for four different binary-form pairs, in four characteristics, including negative/zero lambda and the outer region. Whole-tier rank multisets and an independent floor implementation agree. The absent-H control prevents silently dropping the hypothesis.

original_z_cheapest_sector_controls.scope: Every ordered interval in the retained boundary table is lifted to an entire original sector u>1 by integral monic membership and both endpoint inequalities. Gaussian original bases and floor-rank queries are independent controls; ties are checked as entire tiers, without asserting every tie refinement stays in the region.

uniform_results.family_fan_bound: O(n^(9/4)/r), n=(s+1)^2, uniform in s,r and field
uniform_results.excluded_amplification_regime: r>=sqrt(s) implies O(n^2) full positive fan
uniform_results.cyclic_prefix_quotient: For every integer m>=2, V_D/L_< is Z^3 plus Z/m; beta changes standard membership exactly in characteristics dividing m.
uniform_results.universal_equal_binary_rank: Coefficient-independent whole-tier ranks for x^2+Q+x*H, coprime binary Q,H of degrees 2,r+1, at weights (1+lambda,1,1), -1<lambda<r; O((r+1)*(s+1)) exact operations.
uniform_results.original_z_cheapest_region: Exactly 2*M_(s,r)+4 full initial cones meet w_z<min(w_x,w_y), for s>=r+2, over every field. Entire-tier ranks extend to the closed region. One minimum basis uses O(n) comparisons.
uniform_results.exceptional_characteristic_region: At generic weights, changes can occur only when w_z>min(w_x,w_y); no universal equal-plane cover is proved.

scope: Finite independent exact controls support the uniform proofs in the note. A changed standard set is not a count increase. The original z-cheapest region is now uniformly counted and has an exact rank oracle. Remaining small-order regions, unrestricted G_3, current priority and publication significance remain open.
